description: The panel, served by the daemon at its control port and shown in the main window, and its signal-analysis card undocked into the signal window: they may size the window they live in (compact view), keep the card's window on top, open the recordings folder in the file manager (that folder alone: no file in it can be launched) or show a file in its folder, open web and mail links in the default browser and mail program, and talk to the shell through events alone — the About card's update status and check, the card's undocking. No command of the shell is reachable from them.
